svg.title: DocuShield final system architecture
svg.desc: Complete pipeline: document scan, ledger lookup for frequent crossers, fast-lane quick face match, full detection pipeline with capture quality gate, OCR, parallel validation, CNN tamper detection, face match, and hidden-text check. Any flag routes to human officer review. VSC hardware shown as dashed future-scope integration. All paths converge on a permissioned blockchain audit log.
svg.text: retake — UX only, not a flag
no match → treat as full pipeline
every crossing timestamped — enables frequency tracking
doc ID · timestamp · officer · risk score · decision
Gray = capture/logic · Teal = validation · Coral = tamper detection · Purple = face match
Amber = mandatory human escalation, applies to every flag above
Blue = frequent-crosser fast lane, still fully logged, never skips a face check
Dashed coral = future scope, architecturally planned only
